source_attribute: Securities Practitioner License Certificate Document Code

description: Mã loại CCHN — dư thừa để filter/display nhanh không cần join (= CERTIFICATES.CERTIFICATE_CODE)
ETL-derived: Y nếu Application Type IN ('1','2','3'); N nếu = '0'
etl_logic: LEFT JOIN securities_practitioner_license_application ON securities_practitioner_license_application.sp_license_certificate_document_id = sp_license_certificate_document.sp_license_certificate_document_id AND securities_practitioner_license_application.src_stm_code = 'NHNCK_APPLICATIONS' → CASE WHEN securities_practitioner_license_application.application_tp_code IN ('1','2','3') THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END

description: Ngày thu hồi CCHN — NULL nếu chưa thu hồi
Loại quyết định thu hồi/hủy CCHN — Classification Value (scheme: LICENSE_CERTIFICATE_DECISION_TYPE): 2=Thu hồi, 6=Hủy CCHN; NULL nếu chưa có quyết định
etl_logic: LEFT JOIN sp_license_decision_document revok_dcsn ON revok_dcsn.sp_license_decision_document_id = sp_license_certificate_document.revocation_sp_license_decision_document_id AND revok_dcsn.src_stm_code = 'NHNCK_DECISIONS' LEFT JOIN sp_license_decision_document cncl_dcsn ON cncl_dcsn.sp_license_decision_document_id = sp_license_certificate_document.cancellation_sp_license_decision_document_id AND cncl_dcsn.src_stm_code = 'NHNCK_DECISIONS' → COALESCE(revok_dcsn.decision_tp_code, cncl_dcsn.decision_tp_code)
